reviewExport.hint: ZIP with retained posts, downloaded attachments, image mapping and missing-file notes.
reviewExport.empty: There are no retained posts to export.
reviewExport.failed: Package preparation failed. Stop collection/recognition and retry. Remove old packages if the three-package limit is reached.
reviewExport.missingMain: The selected semantic file has no main Excel. Restore it or select another collection.
reviewExport.statusFailed: Export status or removal could not be confirmed. Retry.
reviewExport.summary: {{retained}} posts · {{images}} originals · {{pending}} pending posts · {{missing}} missing approved images · {{noImages}} posts without exportable images
reviewExport.partial: Partial results or missing images. See package notes and image mapping.

imageSubject.downloadRejected: Image not downloaded or download failed; automatically rejected.
imageSubject.title: Image subject and type recognition
imageSubject.progress: Recognized {{done}} / {{total}} downloaded images; {{missing}} not downloaded; {{failed}} failed.
imageSubject.hint: People, food, publicity posters, advertisement designs, text/design cards and chat/web screenshots are automatically rejected. Scene photographs with neither subject are approved. Blank, blurry or uncertain types need manual review. On-site signs, sculptures, murals, installations and plain scene collages are not rejected merely for containing text. Retries preserve human marks.
imageSubject.autoMarked: Automatically marked: {{decision}}; you can change it
imageSubject.modelMissing: Local model or runtime is incomplete. Check model/model.

suggestions.qualified: Suggested to retain; awaiting human confirmation
suggestions.unqualified: Suggested to exclude; awaiting human confirmation

errors.generic: Recognition is incomplete. Saved results and human marks are preserved; retry is available.
errors.collection_active: Collection is active. Wait before changing image settings.
errors.image_subject_model_missing: The local Qwen model is incomplete.
errors.image_subject_no_downloads: No downloaded images. View the original post instead.
errors.image_subject_key_missing: No SiliconFlow API key configured. Save a key first.
errors.image_subject_key_rejected: API key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.image_subject_cloud_request_rejected: Cloud request rejected. Check model access.
errors.image_subject_cloud_rate_limit: Cloud rate limit reached after retries. Try later.
errors.image_subject_cloud_unavailable: Cloud service unavailable after retries. Try later.
errors.image_subject_cloud_timeout: Cloud request timed out. Try again.
errors.image_subject_cloud_network: Cannot reach SiliconFlow. Check the network.
errors.image_subject_cloud_invalid_response: Invalid cloud result. No automatic decision was made.
errors.image_subject_key_storage_failed: Could not encrypt and save the key.
errors.image_subject_key_use_environment: Use the SILICONFLOW_API_KEY environment variable on this system.

imageSubject.policyPending: Scene collage rules require rechecking; rerun recognition or review manually
imageSubject.manualRequired: Image type uncertain or not yet identified; please review manually
imageSubject.keyMissing: Save a SiliconFlow API key first.

navigationHint: Collection continues when you switch pages. Configuration and output are preserved.

descriptions.config: Set keywords, collection targets and screening rules.
descriptions.console: Read live output, collection progress and errors.
descriptions.data: Browse posts by collection task, separate retained posts from those needing review, and inspect screening records in task details.
descriptions.review: Quickly check model and post decisions. Outcomes are preselected; correct them when needed.
descriptions.logs: Task overview, collection rounds, diagnostics, manual review and AI summary activity.
descriptions.dashboard: Collection, screening and image download statistics for the current task.

logs.commentScope: Persistent failure and single-post retry details. Failed comment collection is excluded from formal results, not treated as zero comments. Missing historical error details are explicitly indicated.
logs.collectionSummary: Latest run: {{groups}} groups below target; collection shortfall {{missing}} posts.
logs.reviewSummary: Human review: {{excluded}} excluded, {{pending}} without outcomes; {{missing}} needed to meet the retention target.
logs.scope: Collection and retention shortfalls are counted separately. Logs persist across restarts.
logs.unknownTime: Time not recorded in old logs
logs.noHistory: No collection logs are associated with this file. Future tasks started from configuration save logs automatically.
logs.noMatches: No records match. Select another run or turn off the shortfalls filter.
logs.outdated: The log endpoint is unavailable. Restart the backend and rescan.
logs.loadFailed: Cannot read logs. Check the associated task files and rescan.

evidence.confirmed_empty: The API explicitly returned an empty list and its no-content message. This group stopped below target.
evidence.unparsed_cards: The API returned cards but no posts were parsed. Check the response structure; content absence is not confirmed.
evidence.no_parsed_posts: No posts were parsed on this page. Actual content absence remains unconfirmed.
evidence.legacy_unknown: An old record says search exhausted, but the original response was not saved. Empty results versus parsing failure cannot be confirmed.
evidence.duplicate_pages: Repeated pages contained only previously processed posts. No new posts were found.
evidence.page_budget: The run reached its page budget below target. This does not prove content absence.
evidence.semantic_unavailable: Text screening was unavailable. Saved pending work remains resumable.
evidence.request_failed: The search request failed. Check the HTTP status; this is not evidence of empty content.
evidence.login_required: The Cookie expired or Weibo requires login verification. Collection stopped; update the Cookie and resume manually.
evidence.parse_failed: The search response could not be parsed. Check its structure; this is not evidence of empty content.
evidence.target_reached: This run reached its collection target.
evidence.searching: Collection is in progress; counts are not final.
evidence.interrupted: Collection was interrupted. Progress was saved without a normal stopping reason.
evidence.not_reached: This group was not processed before the run ended, or its result was not saved.
evidence.not_recorded: No result has been recorded for this group.
evidence.time_range_exhausted: Three consecutive pages in latest order were entirely older than the selected start time; search stopped.

logs.accountScope: Collection exclusions and historical checks; latest 200 entries. Missing historical certification requires review.

saveFailed: This label was not saved. Retry; previously saved labels are preserved.
loadFailed: Unable to load review data. Check that collection is complete and the backend is updated, then retry.
noData: No collection files yet. Review posts here after collection finishes.
noMatches: No posts match this filter. Choose another review status.
accountBatchScope: Applies to this account across the selected file.
accountPostScope: No account identifier was saved. This label applies only to this post; masked names are not merged.
imageHint: Automatic rule: retain personal accounts with at least one approved image; exclude marketing accounts or posts with all images rejected. You can override the final decision.
imageFailed: Image unavailable. Open the original post to inspect it before labeling.
imageNotDownloaded: Image not downloaded. Open the original post before labeling.
noImages: No identifiable image records. Check the original post.

outcomeReasons.keyword_miss: Neither a text field nor an individual comment contains both keywords; excluded.
outcomeReasons.comments_fetch_failed: Comment collection failed; excluded from formal results. See logs for details.
outcomeReasons.images_pending: Continue reviewing images. One approved image is enough to retain the post.
outcomeReasons.retained: At least one image is marked qualified.
outcomeReasons.pet_not_allowed: Jev identified a personal or accompanying pet; excluded.
outcomeReasons.semantic_reject: Jev explicitly rejected this post; excluded.
outcomeReasons.evidence_contradicted: Jev explicitly found contradictory evidence; excluded.
outcomeReasons.account_identity_uncertain: Uncertain account identity; manual review required.
outcomeReasons.text_review_pending: Check whether the evaluation describes the target, then confirm the post decision. Images are not a retention requirement.

supplement.qrLoginRequired: The saved session is missing or expired. Sign in on the configuration page before supplementing.
supplement.title: Replacement collection
supplement.running: Collection is running. Check the console; new posts will return to this review task.
supplement.legacyReady: Review completed. Set the final target and collect replacements.
supplement.legacyPending: Complete review to collect replacements based on retained posts.
supplement.shortfall: {{count}} more posts needed; {{rounds}} collection rounds linked.
supplement.reached: Human retention targets reached; {{rounds}} rounds linked.
supplement.finishReview: Resolve posts that still have no outcome before collecting replacements.
supplement.legacyHint: This older file has no saved target. Confirm the final target per group and use the current configuration settings. Keywords come from this file; these settings will be preserved for future rounds.
supplement.apiKey: Jev API key (optional if available on server; session only)
supplement.cookies: Weibo Cookie (re-enter after restart; session only)
supplement.startFailed: Unable to start replacements. Check configuration and model connectivity.
supplement.backendUnavailable: Replacement service unavailable. Restart the backend and rescan.

reasons.login_required: Cookie expired or verification needed; update Cookie to continue manually
reasons.page_budget: Search budget reached (100 pages per group)
reasons.semantic_unavailable: Semantic service unavailable; retry after recovery

errors.cookies_required: Enter a valid Weibo Cookie to continue.
errors.collection_active: A collection is already running. Wait or stop it first.
errors.target_reached: Retention targets reached; no replacements needed.
errors.supplement_setup_required: Confirm the target and replacement settings.
errors.invalid_keyword_pairs: Check this file's keyword pairs before semantic screening.
errors.supplement_read_failed: A linked file or annotation is unreadable. Restore missing files and retry.

reviewBackendOutdated: The backend is outdated and does not support post decisions. Run the backend restart CMD in the project folder, then return to this page and click Retry. Previously saved marks are preserved.
manualPostOverride: Human correction saved; the selected button is authoritative
accountIdentityPending: Account identity is uncertain; confirm manually.

imageSettings.title: Image recognition settings
imageSettings.keySaved: Saved; leave empty to keep the existing key
imageSettings.saved: Saved. The next recognition job and post-collection recognition will use this provider.
imageSettings.cloudHint: The backend sends images to SiliconFlow using the current policy. Uncertain or failed results require human review. Human decisions take priority. The key is encrypted locally and is not stored in the browser.
imageSettings.localHint: Images are processed locally and are not uploaded.
imageSettings.failed: Could not load or save settings. Please retry.

noImagesTextEvaluation: This post has no images. Review its title, body and comments, then accept or exclude the post using the post decision controls. Images are optional.
imageOnlineFailed: The online image may be expired or restricted by the platform. Retry or open the original post.
imageUrlMissing: No usable image URL was saved. Open the original post to view it.
postReviewInstructions: Review the post content. After approval is saved, the next post opens automatically. The last post stays open.
